messages:
maria-cs: Heads-up — StellarCart reported after the v2.9 rollout some responses are missing the order_items array (used to render line items). They say it started ~an hour after the deploy. Can eng/ML triage and ask them for minimal repro and prompt logs?

sam-eng: Thanks Maria. Can you drop one customer example here and confirm which endpoint + model they hit?

stellarcart-support: Thanks team — they call the Redwood chat endpoint (/v1/chat) with model redwood-v2.9-hosted. Example: input prompt is 'Summarize order #3421 for the checkout page' and the response sometimes omits order_items entirely. We can share the original request payload (no PII).

maria-cs: Copying one redacted payload from them: `{ "user_id": "[redacted]", "messages": [{"role":"system","content":"You are an order-summary service"},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize order #3421 for the checkout page"}], "max_tokens": 400 }`

sam-eng: OK — two quick asks: 1) can you get us 2-3 failing examples (request payload + full response) to reproduce? 2) ask customer to enable prompt-logs for the request_id(s) so we can pull token-level logs. If they can't enable we need the raw responses.

lex-ml: Initial suspicion: model variant mismatch or early truncation of the context causing the structured field to be dropped. Also possible prefix/KV cache interaction after the rollout. We'll need prompt logs + the exact model variant string (including commit/hash if available).

deploy-bot: Deployment note: redwood-v2.9-hosted rolled out to us-west-2 at 2024-06-13T09:12:03Z (coordinated canary -> full).

maria-cs: StellarCart gave one failing response blob (redacted): `{"id":"r-7a1","choices":[{"message":{"content":"Order total: $42.00\n\nShipping: Standard"}}]}` — see it has a human-readable summary but no order_items array. They expect something like `{ "order_items": [ { "sku":"ABC","qty":2,"price":10.0 }, ... ], "total": 42.0 }`.

sam-eng: Thanks. Can you ask for the request_id header they send back? We can also ask them to reproduce with the model pinned to v2.8 (if still available) to compare. Also ask them to run a minimal local curl reproducer and paste output. Example repro to try: 
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an order-summary service"},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize order #3421 for the checkout page"}], "max_tokens":400}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat?model=redwood-v2.9-hosted
```

maria-cs: Customer ran that and attached two request ids: r-7a1 and r-7b3. They gave permission to share the prompt logs (no PII in these examples).

lex-ml: Great — if they enabled prompt logs we can fetch token boundaries and see if the structured-output instruction is being truncated or if the model is producing a summary because sampling/temperature or safety heuristics changed. Also check function-calling / structured-output settings if they were relying on function schema enforcement.

sam-eng: I'm going to run the same curl against a canary pinned to redwood-v2.9-hosted in our internal env and compare with v2.8. Also will look at routing logs for r-7a1 and r-7b3 once we have the logs. Maria — can you drop the raw responses (full JSON) from StellarCart into a secure paste? Prefer not to paste customer JSON publicly.

stellarcart-support: Dropped the two full responses in the secure dropbox link (internal). They also noted one of the responses included "order_items": [] (empty array) and another omitted the key entirely.

lex-ml: If one is empty and another missing, that points to an output formatting regression (model conditioning) rather than a serialization bug on client side. I'll check our eval suites for structured-output regression around the time of the deploy.

sam-eng: Action plan: 1) I will pull prompt logs for r-7a1/r-7b3 and paste the trace here. 2) Lex will run a small A/B using v2.8 vs v2.9 on the exact payload. 3) Maria to collect one more failing example and confirm consent for logs.

maria-cs: Copy — I asked StellarCart for one more failing case and explicit consent to share logs for triage. They said yes and will send within 30m.

deploy-bot: Canary note: traffic rolled from 10% -> 100% between 09:12 and 09:18; no automated rollbacks triggered.

sam-eng: Update: I pulled the prompt logs — here's the relevant snippet from r-7a1 token boundary (redacted): `SYSTEM + USER tokens fit, model produced short 'summary' token sequence and then terminated early with stop_token`. Putting logs into internal trace.

lex-ml: Ran an AB with the exact payload: v2.8 returns structured JSON with order_items present; v2.9 returns a plain text summary in many runs. Repro is consistent at higher temps. Lower temp (0.0) still shows the issue occasionally. Will open a ticket to bisect commit range in v2.9 that changed prefix conditioning.

sam-eng: Noted. I've escalated to infra to check kernel selection / tokenizer changes pushed with v2.9. Also checking if any default streaming/stop token behavior changed.

maria-cs: StellarCart provided the third example. Dropping confirmation: they want a timeline and whether we can roll them back to v2.8 for the short term.

sam-eng: We can offer to pin them to v2.8 for now while we investigate — need approval from product/ops for targeted rollbacks. I'll request it. For triage, please keep sharing any failing payload+full response (3 total now).

lex-ml: Next steps from ML side: 1) bisect between v2.8->v2.9 commit range, 2) check changes to prefix/KV cache and stop_token defaults, 3) add a focused eval that replays StellarCart prompts to confirm fix.

maria-cs: Thanks team. I'll keep the customer updated and post any more logs here. :thumbsup:
